messages:
Maria (CS): Hi team — Pioneer (acct: pioneer-inc) is seeing a burst of 429s right after we handed them the SDK integration guide. Happening within first 5–10 minutes of onboarding traffic. Renew is in Q3 so flagging as high priority :grimacing:
Sam (SDK Eng): ah — thanks for the heads up. Do we have a sample request log or preflight sequence? usually that points to parallel preflight fanout or very short-lived ephemeral tokens
Maria (CS): attaching small snippet from their support capture:```
2026-03-21T15:02:14Z INFO preflight request id=abc123 route=/v1/generate status=429 reason=rate_limited client_id=pioneer-web concurrency=60
2026-03-21T15:02:15Z INFO token issue id=tok-xyz ttl=10s subject=pioneer-session
```
Tony (Solutions Eng): TTL 10s is tiny — looks like every browser tab is exchanging ephemeral tokens and hitting preflight. That plus concurrency=60 will absolutely trigger the proxy limiter. Suggest increase token TTL to 60s for onboarding clients + enable connection reuse in the SDK (see snippet below)
Tony (Solutions Eng):```js
// recommended client option
const r = new RedwoodSDK({
  ephemeralTokenTTL: 60,
  connectionReuse: true,
  preflightBatchWindowMs: 50
})
```
Sam (SDK Eng): also add jittered backoff on retries and cap concurrent preflight attempts. We can push a small SDK hotfix to make TTL default to 30s for first 15 minutes after first successful handshake. @Edge Deploy Bot any objection?
Edge Deploy Bot: deploy pipeline: promoted redwood-sdk-js@1.4.3-hotfix -> canary in us-west-2 (started) :gear:
Maria (CS): Pioneer is on us-west. Can we also temporarily bump their customer rate-plan to exempt preflight checks for 30 minutes? That should buy time while we push the SDK patch. Renewal risk if this keeps happening.
Tony (Solutions Eng): I can create a one-off entitlement: grant preflight grace window (acct:pioneer-inc) for 30m. Will log action and revert. Also enabling connection reuse server-side for their sessions should reduce concurrent sockets.
Sam (SDK Eng): For troubleshooting: ask Pioneer to run a local repro with `NODE_ENV=dev` and the following curl to show handshake pattern:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $EPHEMERAL" -H "X-Client-Id: pioneer-web" \ 
 https://api.redwood.ai/v1/preflight
```
Maria (CS): I sent them a short repro checklist and scheduled a 30-min call in 20m. I'll include the SDK hotfix link and the entitlement note.
Tony (Solutions Eng): We'll also add a quick dashboard card in the Console for "onboarding preflight 429s" so CS sees it in real time.
Sam (SDK Eng): next steps: 1) entitlement bump (Tony) 2) canary hotfix (Edge Deploy Bot) 3) ask Pioneer to switch TTL to 60s and enable connectionReuse (Maria) 4) monitor the onboarding dashboard for 10m after changes.
Maria (CS): perfect. I'll keep Pioneer updated and escalate to AM if we see further spikes. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
